title: Organisation-first platform context v2 (ADR-BCP-027)
description: Versioned extension of existing authoritative runtime and provisioning contexts. Only Control Plane derives/attests primary Organisation; no client-selected legal entity or cross-tenant permission. V1 context contracts remain immutable for pinned consumers.

PlatformContextResolveRequest.description: No new client authority. CP must resolve canonical PRIMARY Organisation even when caller omits an Organisation hint.

PlatformContext.description: RUNTIME context with mandatory attested PRIMARY Organisation, never inferred from DEFAULT LegalEntity.

PlatformContextValidation.description: Resource-server validation of bounded principal/tenant/PRIMARY Organisation authority, including TENANT_PROVISIONING constraints from v1.
